scoreReasons: The specification named https://mcp.visa.com/.well-known/jwks as Visa's key location until at least 2026-10-10 and names no URL now. That JWKS is public and can be polled; on 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-19 it held one RSA sandbox key, which Visa's own code uses to encrypt MCP tokens.
TAP is off-chain and defines no events, receipts or public logs.
Signature-Input parameters (keyid, tag, nonce, timestamps) are visible only to the merchant, the CDN and intermediaries on the path.
As of 2026-10-19 the Agentic Directory has no public list or endpoint, and no count of verifying merchants or signed requests is published (Visa newsroom and developer pages searched).
The sample repository and its pull requests are public, which shows spec activity but not deployment.

public.what: Visa JWKS that the specification named until October 2026
public.how: HTTP GET returns a JWK Set; served with cache-control public, max-age=3600. Poll it to watch for key additions or removals. Its one RSA key serves Visa's MCP token encryption; it is not a confirmed TAP agent key.

public.where: GET /keys with a keyID parameter (host not named in the specification)
public.how: Returns one JWK with kty, kid, use, alg, n and e.
Unversioned pages; diff them over time to detect changes. Visa moved them from /capabilities/ in October 2026, and the move dropped the key URL from the specification.
Commits, pull requests, issues and the GitHub advisories list.
Named merchants, issuers and CDNs with dates.

private.why: Seen only by the merchant, its CDN and intermediaries on the request path.
Personal data sent to the merchant in the request body, also readable by a CDN or proxy that terminates TLS in front of it.
The encrypted payload is readable only by the merchant; the credential hash and card metadata such as lastFour and paymentAccountReference are not encrypted.
Visa feeds TAP data into internal fraud models.
Cloudflare exposes cf.bot_management.signed_agent for Web Bot Auth agents on Enterprise Bot Management; whether TAP verifications set it is not documented.
Bilateral calls between the agent and Visa under /vacp/v1.

indexerCaptures.signal: Key additions and removals in the Visa JWKS
